plan_notes.source_strategy: Lead with outlet RSS / sitemap_news feeds and date archives, not WebSearch. WebSearch site: results skew evergreen. Harvest in this order: phys.org/archive/<dd-mm-yyyy>/ plus phys.org RSS (technology/machine-learning-ai, physics, space, chemistry, biology); techxplore.com machine-learning-ai RSS; sciencedaily.com/news/computers_math/artificial_intelligence/ and its releases RSS; arxiv API (export.arxiv.org/api/query, sortBy=submittedDate, categories cs.AI/cs.LG crossed with astro-ph, physics, q-bio, cond-mat.mtrl-sci, quant-ph; arXiv items only when an outlet or lab blog covers them, or when the lab is notable); eurekalert.org newsroom RSS; quantamagazine.org/feed; newscientist.com RSS (technology, space, physics); space.com, universetoday.com, livescience.com, thequantuminsider.com, physicsworld.com, genengnews.com feeds; deepmind.google/blog, research.google/blog, microsoft.com/research blog, allenai.org blog. Use the query list below only to fill gaps after the feeds.
plan_notes.window: 14 days: publish dates 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-14. Prefer the last 48-72h; older items only if no fresher candidate exists for that angle. Verify each published time on the article page (meta article:published_time / JSON-LD datePublished).

plan_notes.relevance_test: Keep only items where AI actually advances or intersects scientific research or method. Drop pure AI-industry noise (funding, compute, hiring). Clinical and patient-facing items (named disease, trial, FDA) belong to medicine; route them there and do not file under science.
plan_notes.safety_note: Avoid pathogen-enhancement / biosecurity stories entirely. Life-science picks are limited to protein structure, enzymes, therapeutics discovery, genomics and cell biology. Do NOT pick gain-of-function, virus/toxin design, AI-designed phage/viral genomes or bioweapon-adjacent stories; they halt the run. Swap the pick instead of rewording it.
plan_notes.recovery: Run the sequential recovery pass if fewer than 3 verified candidates.
